# Adobe Spectrum CSS

Unmodified compiled CSS distributed under the Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-css
Retrieved from the public npm packages. No runtime npm dependency or build step.

| Local file | Upstream package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| vars.css | @spectrum-css/tokens | 16.0.2 |
| button.css | @spectrum-css/button | 14.2.0 |
| textfield.css | @spectrum-css/textfield | 8.2.0 |
| picker.css | @spectrum-css/picker | 9.2.0 |
| checkbox.css | @spectrum-css/checkbox | 10.2.0 |
| table.css | @spectrum-css/table | 8.2.0 |
| badge.css | @spectrum-css/badge | 6.2.0 |
| fieldlabel.css | @spectrum-css/fieldlabel | 10.2.0 |
| typography.css | @spectrum-css/typography | 8.2.0 |
| card.css | @spectrum-css/card | 11.2.0 |
| link.css | @spectrum-css/link | 7.2.0 |

The components' compiled dist/index.css files include their component-specific theme rules and commons. vars.css is the tokens package's dist/css/index.css, not the retired vars package. Copyright Adobe. Application layout in ../../spectrum.css and ../showcase/showcase.css is project code, not an Adobe product component.
